reason: As someone who has quit two apps and a meal service, I'm more likely to try A. It's upfront about what the A1C numbers can't show, and it covers the things that made me quit before: meal swaps, a menu that rotates every four weeks, no contract, and a call with the dietitian before I start. B has unfilled placeholders like [Service Name], leaves out the no-contract and cancellation terms, and plays up the A1C results.
